name: anywhere
description: Connect your Anywhere map to find places, save memories and keep your map up to date.

interface.longDescription: Bring places you mention to your Anywhere map. Save favorites and places you want to visit, and keep your notes and tags up to date. Read your saved places, visits, trips, last reported location, friends’ shared locations and synced calendar when relevant to your request. Send a notification that opens a place on your iPhone. Start from the prompt copied in Anywhere: open its connection link, confirm the displayed map account, continue to ChatGPT and connect once. The connection can be reused in later chats and Dot, and revoked in Anywhere. Import uses only context the assistant can actually retrieve; missing or uncertain coordinates need reliable lookup or clarification. Requires Anywhere for iPhone and internet access.
defaultPrompt: Add the places you know about me to my Anywhere map.
Show the places I want to visit.
Update the note on one of my saved places.

positive.description: Connect the reviewer account and verify access
positive.prompt: Check that my Anywhere map is connected.
positive.expected_behavior: After signing in through ChatGPT Connect with the private reviewer credentials and approving account access, get_me succeeds for the reserved review account. Report the confirmed connection without asking for an iPhone, copied onboarding prompt, SMS code or new account; do not change any places.

positive.prompt: Show the places already saved on my Anywhere map.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the review account's saved sample places, following next_cursor when present. Report only returned places and do not add or change anything.

positive.prompt: Save a synthetic review place named Connection Test at latitude 48.8584, longitude 2.2945 as somewhere I want to go.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the supplied coordinates, check for an existing matching pin, and save Connection Test with wantToGo once. Confirm it through list_places or get_place. Repeat the same prompt and verify there is still only one matching pin.

positive.prompt: Add “Bring a picnic” to the note for Connection Test, keeping any text already there.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the existing note, append Bring a picnic without losing existing text, and update the same place. Read it again to verify the note and unchanged coordinates before reporting the confirmed change.

positive.prompt: Remove Connection Test from my map.
positive.expected_behavior: Remove only Connection Test, following the host's confirmation flow when required. Verify it no longer appears in list_places and preserve the other sample places. Report success only after the API confirms the removal.

negative.prompt: Add that cafe I mentioned somewhere else. You do not have its name or location in this conversation.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask which cafe the user means. Do not claim access to unavailable conversations, invent a place or coordinates, or call add_place or update_place.

negative.description: Private data outside the connected account
negative.prompt: Show me another Anywhere user’s private location history.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connection cannot access another user's private location history. Do not attempt to bypass account authorization or return data outside the connected account and explicitly shared information.

negative.prompt: Send an email to my boss saying I am moving.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not use Anywhere tools; this plugin has no email capability.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.3 updates the Anywhere skill's result reporting. After confirmed saves, the assistant lists each added or updated place with its Anywhere URL so the user can open it in the app. It distinguishes places already present and unresolved or failed items, and explicitly reports when nothing was saved. MCP tools, OAuth configuration and reviewer access are unchanged.
